name: Saronic
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Saronic is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Saronic Technologies is a privately held defense technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a Series D round announced on March 31, 2026, valued the company at $9.25 billion.

Founded in Austin, Texas in 2022, Saronic designs and builds autonomous surface vessels for naval and maritime customers. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Saronic
round_notes: Saronic has said the Series D proceeds will fund Port Alpha, a new shipyard, and the expansion of its production facilities in Louisiana and Texas.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: The Series D was led by Kleiner Perkins, with new investors including Advent International, Bessemer Venture Partners, DFJ Growth and BAM Elevate. Andreessen Horowitz led the Series B and Caffeinated Capital the Series A. Other investors include 8VC, Elad Gil and Franklin Templeton.
spv_sentence: Since 2023, 25 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Saronic have filed with the SEC, 14 of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Saronic's Series A announcement; reports by Defense One (March 2026), The Robot Report (March 2026) and Washington Technology (July 2024); and SEC Form D filings.
